commit.body:
- app_test job, legs floor (streamlit==1.56.0) and newest, resource_class
  medium, only on develop, master and ci/*; installs the wheel of the commit
  plus streamlit/plotly/pyyaml/pytest in one pip call, runs the suite minus
  browser/source_tree with the provenance lock and the new app-deps lock
- .circleci/check_app_skips.py: skips must be exactly the 5 allowed junit ids
- tests/conftest.py: CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS (off = no change, no import)
- test_compare_core: SAMPLE_DIR -> versioned tests/sample_tracks/ (2 TRACK CSVs)
- publishing jobs require build_test + both app legs
- store_test_results when: always in both test jobs; pip freeze artifact

Design: research/ci_app_tests/etapa0/RELATORIO.md (approved 2026-10-14).
